name: Lifecycle Scope
description: Ownership container for every disposable a component creates - signal connections, tweens, instances, threads, and nested scopes - released in one deterministic LIFO call. Exists because the single largest defect class in long-lived Roblox clients is the undisposed connection or infinite tween: a component whose Show() re-registers an InputBegan listener, or whose looping tween (repeatCount -1) is never cancelled on Hide(), leaks a live handler per cycle. Scopes are re-entrant so a parent view can adopt child panel scopes and tear the whole subtree down at once.

implementations.note: Strict-Luau native module. Deterministic; testable without a DataModel.

provenance: Surfaced by a defect pass over a Roblox fashion-game UI, nine interface modules (2026-09-11): a looping tween started in a panel's build path and never cancelled on Hide(), and a UserInputService.InputBegan handler re-registered on every Show() because Show() calls Initialize(). Searched first: utility.timer_system schedules work rather than owning it, utility.command_bus routes intents, persistence.save_system tracks its own writes only; no component in any of the thirteen categories tracks disposables, so the library has no Maid or Trove equivalent. Library-native, written against Roblox signal, Tween and task semantics.
